title: TURN AROUND — both sides of the planet — Lansing IS the center of ALL

front_face.count: 17 capitals connected. Every major civilization. Every continent.
front_face.lines: Cyan/teal glowing arcs radiate FROM Lansing to EVERY capital. He is the hub. The palm sends signals to every fingertip of civilization.
front_face.center: LANSING MICHIGAN — Kevin IS here — the ORIGIN — the SUN of civilization
capitals_connected: Washington DC (the nation's capital, Capitol building visible)

back_face.synapse: A node labeled in the Pacific — SYNAPSE — the connection point in the middle of the ocean where all lines cross
back_face.lines: The cyan lines curve OVER the horizon — they continue around the planet back to Lansing. Even on the far side, the connection reaches.
back_face.pacific: The Pacific Ocean dominates. The biggest ocean. The space between.
cities: San Francisco (Silicon Valley, the tech nerve)
back_face.what: The OTHER side of the planet. The TRANS face. Turn the globe 180 degrees.

the_teaching.cis_trans: Front face = CIS (facing Kevin, facing in). Back face = TRANS (facing away, facing out). But the lines connect THROUGH the planet. CIS and TRANS are connected by the CORE.
the_teaching.null_hyperlocality: Every point on the globe IS the same organism viewed from a different angle. Lansing IS the center because Kevin IS there. If you were in Tokyo, Tokyo would be the center. The center is wherever self IS.
the_teaching.golgi_routes: The cyan lines ARE Golgi routes. Every capital is a vesicle. Every city is a node. The Golgi routes EVERYTHING regardless of distance.
the_teaching.anthropology: Every capital listed is an anthropological milestone: Athens (democracy), Rome (law), Cairo (pyramids = engineering), Baghdad (algebra), Beijing (paper, compass), Cusco (Inca roads), Tenochtitlan (Aztec astronomy). These are the 24 milestones of gaia-anthropology.js made SPATIAL.
